about: Source data for the 24 hero sheets (docs/sigilbound/art/heroes/*.md, generated by unity/Tools~/heroforge/make-sheets.mjs) and for the batch generator (unity/Tools~/heroforge/heroforge.mjs). Edit here, then regenerate the sheets. Colours come from public/game/art.js LOOKS; skills and roles from public/game/data.js. Prompts must stay free of any other game's, studio's or artist's name (checked by the core tests).

templates.concept2d: Original character design sheet for a stylized fantasy hero-collector game. Full-body front view and back view side by side, T-pose with arms straight out to the sides, palms down, legs slightly apart, neutral relaxed face, plain flat light-grey background, even soft studio light, no cast shadows. Hand-painted stylized look, chunky readable shapes, slightly enlarged head, hands and weapon, about six heads tall. {subject} Weapon shown separately beside the figure, upright. Main colour {main}, accent {accent}{glowText}, element mood {elementWords}.
templates.text3d: Stylized hand-painted fantasy hero, game-ready full-body character, {pose}, arms straight out from the shoulders, legs apart, fingers spread and separated, neutral face, symmetrical, standing on the ground plane, facing forward. {subject} Chunky readable silhouette, about six heads tall, clean separated limbs, empty hands (no weapon held), cloth and hair clear of the arms and legs. Main colour {main}, accent {accent}{glowText}.
templates.weapon3d: Stylized hand-painted fantasy prop, game-ready, single object, upright on the ground plane, centered, no character, no base or stand. {weapon}. Main colour {main}, accent {accent}{glowText}.
templates.texture: Hand-painted stylized texture, soft painterly brush strokes, baked ambient occlusion and a gentle top-down light gradient, no hard cast shadows, no photographic detail, clean colour blocks with crisp edge highlights on metal and trim, warm rim on the upper surfaces, saturated but not neon. Main colour {main}, accent {accent}{glowText}. Skin painted with warm subsurface tones. {textureNotes}
